biggest_catch: The friend must physically present your referral card, letter, or email offer at a Sunflower Bank location when opening their first personal checking account - a referral sent only online with no card in hand may not count.
catches: Customer must be an owner on a personal checking account at Sunflower Bank to participate.
Referring customer earns $50 when the referee opens their first personal checking account; referee must present the referral card, letter, or email offer at account opening.

All referral payments deposited into the referring customer's primary personal checking account at the time the payment is earned; the qualifying account must be open and have a positive balance on the date the referee account is opened.
Minimum $100 to open a personal checking account; maximum payment per customer is $500 per calendar year (January 1-December 31).
Referrer may receive a Form 1099-MISC for reportable taxable income; offer subject to change/cancellation at any time without notice.
